sentences.en: Kabyle is the Berber vernacular I use and I'll stick to it.
sentences.zh: 卡比勒语是我在使用的柏柏尔本国方言，我将继续使用它。

sentences.en: I write Berber in its Kabyle vernacular form.
sentences.zh: 我用柏柏尔语的卡比勒方言形式来书写。

sentences.en: He uttered an incomprehensible oath in the local vernacular before going on his way.
sentences.zh: 他用当地土语发了一个听不懂的诅咒，然后继续上路。
